summary: Uniti Group subsidiaries Uniti Services, UGF and CSL Capital reported results of previously announced asset-sale-based tender offers for their 4.750% Senior Secured Notes due 2028 and 7.500% Senior Secured Notes due 2033. By the 5:00 p.m. New York City expiration on August 20, 2026, $554,108,000 of 2028 Notes and $1,368,000 of 2033 Notes were validly tendered and not withdrawn, exceeding the $480,236,000 maximum offer amount, so tenders were prorated. On August 21, 2026 the Issuers accepted $479,054,000 of 2028 Notes and $1,182,000 of 2033 Notes, with settlement expected Monday, August 24, 2026. Watch proration and residual note overhang.
